evidence_and_rationale: R5 Kelvin pads are physically distinct, yet `R/return-path19b.txt` routes `bus_fault_hot` beside/under `ocp_kelvin_p`; R5/U8/U9 pad/net check above confirms the shared reference. `D:790-791` gives a DC Kelvin estimate 158.08 mΩ and OCP band, not switching-frequency shared impedance. High-frequency injection into the fault reference remains credible.
Pin-to-pin U8/U9 and OCP capture during commutation plus extracted shared impedance and magnetic pickup corner.

criteria.topic: Reference continuity across transitions
evidence_and_rationale: Stage19b fixes the old `pwm_hb` J4 changes: all seven now 1.12–2.72 mm from a transfer cap (`R/return-path19b.txt`), corroborated by my cap/via check. Yet `bias_bad` remains seven transitions at 2.81–15.76 mm and a 22.25 mm B.Cu no-plane stretch x≈44–66,y=127.2; `bias_bad_raw` also has distant changes. U40.4→U22/U23 DIS assertion is a functional path. A transient disable might truncate a switching pulse; “fail-safe direction” at `D:789` does not quantify that sequence.
Measure U40 output and both DIS pins through rail faults/startup and switching aggressors; test whether any pulse causes unsafe commutation or nuisance trip.

criteria.topic: Current path proximity and parallel conductors
evidence_and_rationale: Local U1/U2 100 nF planar loops are 2.20 mm pad-centre and stage9 applied a +2 nH gate-port sensitivity bound with 252/252 simulations (`D:185-198`). Opposite-current gate return and film placements are intentional; my C10/C17 check agrees. This is a supported design prediction, pending port extraction/measurement.
Extract both gate-port and commutation-loop L/mutuals with exact via/plane contact, compare to capture.

criteria.topic: Separate capacitor jobs
evidence_and_rationale: Source assigns distinct driver 100 nF/1 µF/10 µF (`B/source/elec/src/power_stage_120v.ato:112-160`), rail reservoir plus 0.68 Ω-damped 220 µF (`B/source/elec/src/f6_bias.ato:5-48`), local film C38–41 and remote C5/C6 (`B/section.kicad_pcb` objects above). `D:455-456` uses exact TDK 9 µF film; `D:155` explicitly does not credit 10 µF DC-bias capacitance. Jobs are separated, but the requested per-capacitor ripple/life stress calculation is incomplete in this evidence.
Per-exact-part voltage, ripple, thermal and life stress table at 22/28 A and fault/burst cases.

criteria.topic: Rail impedance versus load spectrum
evidence_and_rationale: `D:103-109,127-129` requires the negative rail <−1.6 V during partner edge and ≥2.2 µF effective reservoir; a standalone model is the chosen bound while a coupled rail deck had 181/504 indeterminate cases. Local U1/U2 bypass is real, but no installed VSS/VDD pin impedance or edge droop is given. Since the F6 off-gate margin depends directly on that rail, uncertainty is concrete.
Gate-charge current spectra, impedance/load-step at each VDDA/VSSA and VDDB/VSSB pair, synchronized VSS-to-negative rail captures.

criteria.topic: Mounted, not catalog, bypass inductance
evidence_and_rationale: My board measurements verify 2.20 mm driver 100 nF loops and ~2.8–2.9 mm RECOM/LDO 100 nF pad distances. `H/pi-distances.json` deliberately does not assert 10 µF RECOM returns (5.69–5.70 mm), U26 input/NR returns (6.97/5.19 mm); `H/bypass-check.json` checks 11 IC geometric screens. None calculates package+pad+plane ESL, so a 3 mm pad screen cannot validate the stated ~0.1 nH aggregate HF reservoir assumption in `B/source/elec/src/f6_bias.ato:9`. The absence of an L estimate makes this U rather than a proven 1-level degradation.
Extract or measure mounted impedance at U1/U2 and U26/U41/U42 pins, including actual capacitor DC bias.

criteria.topic: Antiresonance and damping
evidence_and_rationale: `B/source/elec/src/f6_bias.ato:13-45` parallels 10 µF, 1 µF, 100 nF and 0.68 Ω/220 µF branches; stage19b adds four V3V3–SELV_GND 100 nF parts (`B/source/elec/src/power_stage_120v.ato:836-854`). There is no rail impedance sweep, ESR/ESL mounting model, load spectrum or allowable peak. Mixed values alone do not prove harmful antiresonance.
Rail-by-rail impedance sweep/model and time response with installed caps, regulator, package, plane and load.

criteria.topic: Bulk versus fast local energy
evidence_and_rationale: C38–41's HF film pads sit by the FET row while C5/C6's 9 µF pads are remote; `D:426-427` explicitly says S4 bulk-path inductance ~20 nH ±50% and failure around 28–32 nH. Local film is the intended fast route, but bulk-path uncertainty is a credible worst-case gap.
Exact C5/C6→FET extraction or current/voltage transient at the row through start, shutdown, repetitive S4/S5 and 28 A.

criteria.topic: Placement sensitivity and stackup
evidence_and_rationale: `R/pi19b.txt` and my checks establish short pad-centre geometry; `R/return-path19b.txt`/my via check establish transfer via proximity. No comparison of mounting/spreading L across the actual stackup or plane cavity exists for the RECOM, LDO, V3V3 and gate rails.
Stackup dielectric/copper data and calculated/extracted path-impedance comparison for the installed placements.

criteria.topic: Decide when a net is electrically long
evidence_and_rationale: `R/return-path19b.txt` maps seven `pwm_hb` and seven `bias_bad` transitions and U40 ns-class propagation is recorded at `D:789`. Flight time, fastest rise time at J4/U22/U23, source/load impedance and receiver margin are absent; 22.25 mm no-plane length is a return concern, not proof of an electrically long line.
Actual fastest edges, routed/cable length and propagation speed, receiver threshold/noise bound.

criteria.topic: Termination matched to topology
evidence_and_rationale: Source places 3.9 Ω resistors in MOSFET gate paths (`B/source/elec/src/power_stage_120v.ato:178-193`) and 100 Ω in PERMIT (`:90-105`); these serve gate-current/drive shaping, not demonstrated digital line matching. J4/controller source topology and PWM receiver waveforms are unavailable.
J4 harness/source/loading topology and source/receiver captures; choose termination only if reflection budget requires it.

criteria.topic: Discontinuity inventory
evidence_and_rationale: Seven `pwm_hb` vias, seven `bias_bad` vias, J4 launch and branches are mapped (`R/return-path19b.txt`; board `pwm_hb` 34 tracks/7 vias, `bias_bad` 58/7 by pcbnew). No edge-to-flight assessment or impedance-step effect is supplied.
Feature map with cable/connector/branch dimensions, waveform or TDR only for paths found electrically long.

criteria.topic: Delay and matching tied to a timing budget
evidence_and_rationale: `D:60,72,74,76,185-198` gives 49.9 kΩ DT, nominal ~442 ns dead time, controller gap and a modelled +2 nH gate sensitivity; producer recognizes command gap differs from gate-crossing gap. Simulations support the chosen timing at declared 180° mode, without measured gate timing.
Synchronized controller input, driver output and four MOSFET VGS crossing measurements at hot/cold, burst S5 and faults.

criteria.topic: Material and trace loss where it matters
evidence_and_rationale: The board's relevant J4/PWM/control routes are short low-voltage signals, with no identified high-speed serial channel or loss/eye requirement (`B/section.kicad_pcb`, J4 and U1/U2 nets). Power-copper AC loss belongs to SI-28, not a digital insertion-loss criterion. Revisit if a fast off-board channel is added.
None for current architecture; reassess after a channel requirement change.

criteria.topic: Rank aggressor/victim pairs
evidence_and_rationale: High `dv/dt` SW_A/SW_B runs near gate/sense regions; R5 Kelvin at (37,12–13) is beside the FET row, and `D:482,503` estimates magnetic pickup from the coil. Stage19b bus-fault reference is repaired, but no combined SW/copper/coil aggressor ranking against victim thresholds exists.
3D coupling/extraction plus worst simultaneous commutation and coil-field victim pin captures.

criteria.topic: Guard trace claims
evidence_and_rationale: No claimed dedicated guard-trace remedy appears in the stage19b source, PCB change log or return-path record (`B/source/elec/src/power_stage_120v.ato:836-854`; `D:767-791`). The Kelvin paired return and plane transfers are functional conductors, not an A/B guard-trace claim.
Reopen only if a guard is proposed; compare against equal spacing without it.

criteria.topic: Differential pair return and symmetry
evidence_and_rationale: R5 Kelvin pads form a dedicated pair at (37.0,12.1/13.1), but `D:692,701,791` moves part of the return from B.Cu to In2, re-solves DC Kelvin resistance at 158.08 mΩ; `R/return-path19b.txt` routes `bus_fault_hot` against the positive Kelvin reference. Differential geometry and common-mode response under switching/coil field are not quantified.
Exact pair/return asymmetry map, CT/Kelvin common-mode range, switching/coil pickup capture at comparator pins.

criteria.topic: Common-mode conversion and cables
evidence_and_rationale: `D:792-806` has a source-bound conducted-EMI model using 31.0 pF floating-pan / 91.4 pF earthed-pan coil-to-PE estimates. It predicts ≥6.5 dB sensitivity margin floating but only 1.7–2.6 dB for earthed pan at 60 kHz; >~0.5 MHz lumped result is explicitly distrusted. J2/J5 cable current and PE route are unmeasured. Specific earthed-pan/common-mode sensitivity warrants concern, though it is informational rather than a compliance fail.
Assembled coil/chassis capacitance, J2/J5 current probe and LISN scans in pan/no-pan, 22/28 A and burst states.

criteria.topic: Crosstalk evidence at the victim
evidence_and_rationale: `R/return-path19b.txt` maps `bias_bad` and fault paths; `D:790-791` reports Kelvin band calculations. No simultaneous switching capture at U8/U9, U22/U23, CT comparator or J4 receiver demonstrates noise or fault latency.
Simultaneous aggressor and victim-pin waveforms against explicit thresholds/latency under S4/S5 and steady 28 A.

criteria.topic: Instrument matches the question
evidence_and_rationale: D-8 double-pulse and synchronized gate/VDS plan is named at `D:72,74`; conducted-EMI bench plan uses LISN RBW and pan/current modes at `D:806`. The choices fit the question, but no probe loop, port, de-embedding or uncertainty record is supplied for stage19b; the rubric's 2 anchor requires uncertainty bounded inside predicted margin.
Fixture/probe bandwidth/loading and uncertainty budget; calibrate and retain raw captures.

criteria.topic: Verify uncertainty and worst case
evidence_and_rationale: The 252/252 per-leg F6 matrix at `F:39` spans 27/100/150 °C, and `D:127-129` bounds −1.6 V rail. Yet model-port corrections are provisional and the ~20 nH ±50% bulk inductance (`D:426-427`) enters a 28–32 nH failure region. One uncertain corner could overturn the predicted S4 margin.
Exact-board corrected/fine extraction, component/rail/probe sensitivity, measured worst-case S4/S5 corners.

criteria.topic: Copper resistance with the right current distribution
evidence_and_rationale: `D:790-791` gives Kelvin resistance/band; the later converged body model at `D:808-827` supersedes the old B3 peak-cell conclusion and retains film-cap/local-air bench holds. Board's 2 oz inner/outer current paths have current/thermal design work, with exact R5 interface checked here. This supports a prediction, but there is no fabricated temperature/current distribution measurement for stage19b and AC crowding is not completely validated.
22/28 A IR/thermal map, ripple spectrum and resistance/skin/crowding sensitivity on actual copper.

criteria.topic: Parasitic capacitance and displacement-current route
evidence_and_rationale: `D:103-105` recognizes an earlier SELV-fed transformer path would couple switch nodes to PE; stage19b retains HOT-fed RECOM architecture. `D:792-806` models coil-to-PE capacitance and a harmful bus-to-PE Y-cap resonance; the board has SW planes and PE/chassis/cable exits visible in `H/copper.png`. The model's 60 kHz earthed-pan margin is narrow and >~0.5 MHz is untrusted.
Extract node→sense/PE/heatsink/cable capacitance and return, then measure common-mode and victim current under worst `dv/dt`.

criteria.topic: Define the real operating envelope before accepting a rating
evidence_and_rationale: 28 A/50 °C and fault sweeps exist, but selected-part hot, ripple and abnormal-case margins are incomplete, especially film caps/supplies. Consolidate one stress table at matched datasheet conditions.

criteria.topic: Size capacitors by effective function, not marked microfarads
evidence_and_rationale: C5/C6 bus, B32654 tank, C38–41 HF and ceramics have distinct jobs; bank winding/hot spot and HF-cap thermal paths lack measured support. Measure ripple spectra, actual bias capacitance and hot-spot temperature.

criteria.topic: Treat inductors and transformers as lossy magnetic parts
evidence_and_rationale: C,D: `DEC:481-507,543-552,757`; `BOM:37`; `P/validation-results/02-protection-timing/README.md:16-25`
Coil Rac and CT volt-second screens are calculated, T1 and EMI choke temperature/HF insulation remain sample/bench questions. Measure wound coil, T1 phase/saturation and L1 rise.

criteria.topic: Select rectifiers and clamps for transients, not DC forward drop alone
evidence_and_rationale: D,S: `ATO:697-730`; `BOM:60`; `P/validation-results/08-manufacturing-package/native-21/sourcing/alt-circuits-2026-10-09/ALT-D3.md:62-90`; `DEC:435`

D3/D17 series bus clamp was selected for a modeled long pulse; no selected-part worst-case repetitive/long-pulse and real overshoot capture. Check current split, pulse energy, reverse recovery and VDS at hot corners.

criteria.topic: Audit connector systems as components with failure modes
evidence_and_rationale: J2/J5/J7–J10 REDCUBE, J3/J11 VH and J4 interface are identified, but mating halves, loaded harness hot contact rise and pull/strain relief are not qualified across all exits. Sample assembly and harness test.

criteria.topic: Keep calibration adjustments from becoming the accuracy strategy
evidence_and_rationale: D: exact 92-line `BOM` scan; `ATO:568-615`; `P/validation-results/02-protection-timing/README.md:70-77`
No trimmer/pot MPN in frozen BOM; fixed shunt/reference ratios set protection. Document production calibration and threshold distribution; no physical verification.

criteria.topic: Account for resistor behavior beyond initial tolerance
evidence_and_rationale: D,C,V: `ATO:568-635,997,1047-1048`; `BODY:51-73`; [Bourns CSS2H datasheet](https://bourns.com/docs/product-datasheets/css2h-2512.pdf?sfvrsn=905c9af1_35)
R5 1 mΩ/5 W terminal curve is relevant, but its temperature point/contact geometry need Bourns clarification and bench IR. Recheck divider, bleeder and gate-resistor pulse/hot voltage ratings.

criteria.topic: Select the switch topology and technology against actual voltage, loss, and frequency
evidence_and_rationale: D,S,V: `BOM:35`; `P/validation-results/03-loss-thermal-budget/round3/README.md`; `P/validation-results/01-switching-parasitics/round17/delegation/out-D31/README.md`; `P/validation-results/01-switching-parasitics/round5/bench-plan/sources/infineon-ipw65r018cfd7.pdf:pp1-4`
Selected 650 V CFD7 at four bridge positions has modeled normal/fault loss. Manufacturer data has 18 mΩ max at 10 V/25 °C and 495 A pulse at 25 °C case; losses and hot switching need bench waveforms.

criteria.topic: Verify fully enhanced gate drive at the hot and low-supply corners
evidence_and_rationale: D,S,V: `ATO:53-224,896-940`; `DEC:89-106`; Infineon CFD7 PDF pp.3-4
Independent +15/−2 V bias with monitor is credible, but startup/brownout, rail droop and hot VGS at package pins are unmeasured. Test minimum line, burst first edge, fan fault and TCO decay.

criteria.topic: Make gate-drive current a transient calculation
evidence_and_rationale: D,S: `ATO:177-224`; `P/validation-results/01-switching-parasitics/round5/bench-plan/`; Infineon CFD7 PDF pp.4-5
Gate network is defined; actual 234 nC typical charge and parasitic loop make peak-driver rating insufficient. Capture VGS, VDS and current on both legs; integrate Eon/Eoff.

criteria.topic: Include output capacitance and body-diode recovery in commutation
evidence_and_rationale: V,S: Infineon CFD7 PDF pp.1,5-6 (Eoss 31.6 µJ at 400 V; Qrr specified under test conditions); `DEC:81-90`; `P/validation-results/01-switching-parasitics/round17/`
F6 simulations include difficult S4/S5 commutation, but recovery under real pan/detune and temperature is unmeasured. Capture dead-time diode current and switching-node overshoot.

criteria.topic: Prove off-state and gate-oxide protection in abnormal states
evidence_and_rationale: 10 kΩ gate-source holds, −2 V bias, turn-off branch and rail monitor form a credible mechanism; F6 simulated 288 S4 and 216 S5 cases. Verify off-gate/rail-valid behavior through reset, disconnected controller and brownout at hot devices.

criteria.topic: Separate repetitive switching SOA from fault and linear SOA
evidence_and_rationale: S,V: `P/validation-results/01-switching-parasitics/round17/delegation/out-D31/README.md:8-22`; Infineon CFD7 PDF pp.2-3
Fault turn-off 60–330 A modeled VDS ≤350 V, but transient V-I locus and hot SOA for startup, short, stuck gate and detune have no physical verification. Pulse headline is not fault qualification.

criteria.topic: Close the complete junction-to-ambient thermal path
evidence_and_rationale: Converged body model corrects mesh artifact and gives margins for R5/U41/U42/U26, but assumes h, package coupling and many passive paths. Bench IR/thermocouples and measured sink/fan airflow required.

criteria.topic: Design fault interruption as part of the power path
evidence_and_rationale: D,C,S: `ATO:568-696`; `DEC:78`; D-31 README:8-22; `P/prototype-closure/round5/protection/README.md:123-175`
CT/OCP/OVP and gate disable exist; DC fuse/contactors/catch and current extinction remain unqualified. Inject faults, bound whole latency and remaining energy; qualify vendor DC interrupt data.

criteria.topic: Write an error budget for each protected or controlled quantity
evidence_and_rationale: C,D: `P/validation-results/02-protection-timing/kelvin/budget-native21s19b.md`; `DEC:527-552`; `P/validation-results/06-controller-interface/README.md:260-273`
CT and shunt threshold bands exist, but one input-referred current/bus/temperature/ADC/reference/firmware budget is missing. Include drift, lost rail, noise and sample freshness.

criteria.topic: Verify precision resistor ratios and shunt temperature, not just absolute resistance
evidence_and_rationale: Four-terminal R5 land and paired sense fingers are concrete; return shifts trip −2.17 A. Bourns terminal point, Kelvin contact geometry and element temperature are open; bench threshold versus current/temperature.

criteria.topic: Check analog front-end common-mode range, input return path, and recovery
evidence_and_rationale: D,C: `ATO:568-696,737-835`; `P/validation-results/02-protection-timing/README.md:80-161`

Comparator and AMC1311 paths defined; old SPICE subset misses small-overdrive guaranteed delay and full CT cases, with no overdrive recovery capture. Check lost sensors, rail minimum and saturation recovery.

criteria.topic: Preserve differential sensing in the presence of mismatch and switching fields
evidence_and_rationale: D,C: `DEC:682-710,502-507,775-789`; `P/validation-results/02-protection-timing/coil-pickup/PICKUP.md`; S PCB R5 Kelvin routes
R5 sense pair re-laid tightly and coil-field pickup modeled. Verify real ferrite coil, harness motion, hot leakage and loaded threshold; the 5.2 mV worst pickup case is model-only.

criteria.topic: Set bandwidth from control and protection timing, then budget noise
evidence_and_rationale: C,S: `P/validation-results/02-protection-timing/README.md:15-42,70-161`; D-31 README:8-22

CT filter phase and detector delays have bounded/model subsets, but comparator small-overdrive delay, full alias/noise and loaded hardware step response remain open. Measure injected-current trip-to-extinction.

criteria.topic: Route return currents so power drops do not become measurements
evidence_and_rationale: D,H: `P/validation-results/08-manufacturing-package/native-21/stage19-pi-si/README.md:17-85`; `S/provenance/copper.json`

Stage19b reports bus_fault_hot reference samples 0 over another net and pwm_hb all seven transfers within 3 mm; frozen copper confirms routing identity. Verify ground shift and Kelvin voltage at load.

criteria.topic: Test radiated, capacitive, and magnetic coupling as distinct paths
evidence_and_rationale: C,S: `DEC:793-806`; `P/validation-results/07-conducted-emi/s19b/README.md`; `P/validation-results/02-protection-timing/coil-pickup/PICKUP.md`

Coil-to-PE capacitance and near-field pickup modeled, with updated floating-pan one-factor sensitivity margin 6.50 dB and an informational earthed-pan range 1.7–2.6 dB; no assembled capacitance or EMI measurement. Measure coil-to-PE split and sensor pickup separately.

criteria.topic: Make decoupling and supply filtering stable and local
evidence_and_rationale: Stage19 moved RECOM/LDO caps to within ~1.6–2.9 mm and stage19b added PWM transfer caps; exact-board prior gates pass. Check rail impedance, regulator stability and droop during turn-on/fault.

criteria.topic: Follow the complete mains protection and isolation path
evidence_and_rationale: D,C: `FAB:17-33`; `DEC:331-345,745-758`; `S/section.kicad_dru`; S board J6/F1/RES_A

F1/Class CC, X2 discharge, PE connection and 12.6 mm RES_A outer rule are defined; CTI, clip approval, same-layer inner path, HF/PD and installed harness remain lab/vendor decisions. Obtain written approvals and tests.

criteria.topic: Size fuse and input parts from actual RMS, inrush, and fault waveforms
evidence_and_rationale: D,C: `DEC:331-345,628-635`; `P/prototype-closure/round5/protection/README.md:123-175`; `BOM:3,43`

F1 input fuse and F2 blower tap are selected; F2 200 A interrupt against prospective fault and F1 clip compatibility remain certifier/first-article questions. Measure line RMS, inrush, I²t and staged fault coordination.

criteria.topic: Account for stored energy and discharge after power removal
evidence_and_rationale: X2 discharge recalculated 0.854 s after R1/R2 swap; bus bleeds modeled. Measure residual voltage for unplug, open fuse/contact, one failed bleeder and maximum capacitance; use actual service-access model.

criteria.topic: Check auxiliary supply behavior during startup, brownout, and power failure
evidence_and_rationale: D,S: `ATO:472-489,896-940`; `DEC:86-106`; `P/validation-results/06-controller-interface/README.md:147-160`; `BOM:41,44,86`

PS2 HOT rail TCO-switched, U41/U42 isolated high-side modules and monitors are concrete; lost-rail default and back-power from controller remain unresolved. Capture all rails, PERMIT, DIS, VGS during line ramps/abrupt loss.

criteria.topic: Use reference designs as empirical starting points and test their parasitic omissions
evidence_and_rationale: D,S,V: stage19 PI/SI README:28-49; `P/validation-results/01-switching-parasitics/round17/`; [RECOM R24C2T25/R PDF](https://recom-power.com/pdf/Econoline/R24C2T25_R.pdf)
RECOM local-cap guidance is implemented, F6 simulations use candidate models, but PCB parasitics and load-dependent commutation need first-article waveforms and snubber heat.

criteria.topic: Treat an isolator as a timed power-and-signal channel
evidence_and_rationale: D,V: `ATO:636-696,896-940`; `DEC:757`; [RECOM R24C2T25/R PDF](https://recom-power.com/pdf/Econoline/R24C2T25_R.pdf); `P/validation-results/06-controller-interface/README.md:308-312`

ISO7710 default-high and isolated UCC21550/RECOM chains provide a defined architecture; actual CMTI, skew, UVLO and output-fault timing under the board's dv/dt are unmeasured. Test each isolated channel and loss of its output rail.

criteria.topic: Prove high-side supply hold-up for every commanded pattern
evidence_and_rationale: Stage19b's high-side U41/U42 RECOM supplies are independent, not bootstrapped. Check isolated-rail hold-up under AOE-27/29.

criteria.topic: Protect every off-board logic/sensor input at the physical boundary
evidence_and_rationale: D: `P/validation-results/06-controller-interface/README.md:50-71,147-169`; S board J4/T1/J3/J11

J4 system integration and power-off injection/ESD loads are not closed; local clamps alone do not show return path safety. Freeze mating harness and inject ESD/miswire/hot plug at actual enclosure boundary.

criteria.topic: Route fast digital signals with a defined return and termination when needed
evidence_and_rationale: D,H: stage19 PI/SI README:51-85; S board pwm_hb, ct_zc, BUS_FAULT, J4
Seven pwm_hb layer changes now have transfer caps ≤2.72 mm; ct_zc has one 1.84 mm referenced change. Need edge/overshoot timing capture with final harness, especially PERMIT and fault.

criteria.topic: Design ADC channel filtering and sampling together
evidence_and_rationale: D: `P/validation-results/06-controller-interface/README.md:260-273`; `DEC:75-77`; S J4

Power-stage sensing interface is defined, but final controller ADC acquisition/reference, source impedance, anti-alias and channel timing were not provided as a qualified integrated artifact here. Freeze controller revision and measure sampled switching tones/steps.

criteria.topic: Select ADC/DAC architecture by the error that matters to the loop
evidence_and_rationale: D: `DEC:75-77`; controller-interface README:260-273

ESP32-S3/receiver plan mentions ADC1, 20 ksample/s and 150 µs freshness, but final effective bits, reference drift, simultaneity and firmware latency are not established on STAGE19B system. Review controller and capture conversion timing/error.

criteria.topic: Make each BOM line a buildable, traceable choice
evidence_and_rationale: D,H: `FAB:10-15,39-59`; `BOM:1-92`; `P/validation-results/08-manufacturing-package/native-21/cpl-rotation-audit/audit.csv:181`

92 source lines, 357 placements and fab package exist; R5 is `NEEDS-PREVIEW`, U41/U42 fine pitch and via capping/stackup require supplier confirmation. Inspect JLC preview, solder coupons/first article and exact MPN substitutions.

criteria.topic: Qualify supply and lifecycle without mistaking the book's directory for live inventory
evidence_and_rationale: D: `P/validation-results/08-manufacturing-package/native-21/sourcing/README.md`; `FAB:50-59`; `P/validation-results/08-manufacturing-package/native-21/sourcing/ALTERNATES-2026-10-09.md:548-553`

2026-10-08/09 survey is time-stamped and multiple exact parts are consigned or thin-stock; earlier alternate tables predate later C5/C6/D3 changes. Refresh authorized stock/PCN and qualify electrical/land alternatives before ordering.

criteria.topic: Make the measurement setup part of the evidence
evidence_and_rationale: D: `P/native-21/BRINGUP-PROBES.md:1-52`; `BODY:95-102`; `P/validation-results/01-switching-parasitics/round5/bench-plan/`

Domain-paired probe pads and rated differential/isolated probe rule are specified, but no STAGE19B raw waveforms, probe transfer, trigger, bandwidth or first-article thermal setup exist. Record calibrated setup and raw captures for every claimed margin.

criteria.topic: Identify the job of every magnetic element
evidence_and_rationale: L1 cancels useful mains current, its leakage contributes DM; external coil is tank energy transfer; T1 senses tank current. Confirm fault/start/trip currents in assembled wiring.

criteria.topic: Derive an operating envelope before choosing catalog curves
evidence_and_rationale: 28 A hardware, 29.4 A RMS trip, 35–60 kHz and pan Monte Carlo are modeled; coil/pan complex impedance and hot waveforms are unmeasured. Characterize representative pans, offset/no-pan and trip.

criteria.topic: Distinguish the interference mode and frequency
evidence_and_rationale: M: EMI:1–8,30–58; EMI`results.json`; bench plan `BENCH-PRECOMPLIANCE.md`:17–44
Model separates low-band CM from 2fs DM, but no mode-separated LISN/port spectra. Measure L/N phasors or hybrid, PE and coil cable.

criteria.topic: Define the useful signal band that filtering must preserve
evidence_and_rationale: D/M: S`power_stage_120v.ato`:737–780; TANK:105–136; EMI:46–58
35–60 kHz tank and CT trip/zero-cross paths are specified and modeled. Verify CT phase/trip fidelity and rail/startup behavior with filter fitted.

criteria.topic: Separate thermal current rating from saturation current
evidence_and_rationale: V/D/M: TDK datasheet pp. 4–5; Coilcraft PDF p. 1; DCS:526–552; TH:73–79

TDK's 20 A is at +60 °C ambient, and its <10% bias drop is specified at +20 °C; tank 28 A is not L1 line current. Coilcraft's 88 A is a rise reference. Test hot L1/CT under actual line and trip waveforms.

criteria.topic: Check bias-dependent impedance and inductance
evidence_and_rationale: V/M: TDK datasheet p. 4; EMI:40–58, limitations; DCS:477–478

The required off-board ≥100 µH DM module has no selected discrete inductor or hot/bias curve. L1 cancellation does not bound its leakage or imbalance under fault/inrush. Select part and sweep Z/L at bias and heat.

criteria.topic: Treat AC copper loss as distinct from DCR
evidence_and_rationale: V/M: TDK p. 4 DCR; EMI:limitations and recommendation 5; SPEC:17–42
4.5 mΩ is +20 °C DC typical. Inlet harmonic spectrum/hot R_ac and module winding loss are not measured; coil loss is modeled separately. Measure winding rise and spectrum-weighted AC resistance.

criteria.topic: Account for core loss with the real flux waveform
evidence_and_rationale: M: CT:112–115; SPEC:rows 7,12; TDK pp. 4–5

CT 46.3/638 V·µs at a modeled 160 A fault supports one flux corner; coil ferrite and inlet core loss under real nonsinusoidal flux lack material/waveform validation. Measure hot field/waveform and temperature.

criteria.topic: Confirm thermal aging and neighboring heat
evidence_and_rationale: Converged board model supersedes old 136/182 °C raster peaks, but L1's assumed 125 °C class limit and 68.6 °C estimate are not verified; coil/ferrite/enclosure hot spots lack equilibrium data. Soak final assembly at high ambient.

criteria.topic: Check parasitic capacitance and self resonance
evidence_and_rationale: V/M: TDK p. 5 typical parallel-winding impedance magnitude; EMI:network/limitations
TDK plot was fitted (model resonance about 0.8–0.9 MHz); there is no tabulated phase/capacitance or mounted sweep. Measure installed CM/DM Z and phase through 30 MHz.

criteria.topic: Verify insulation, voltage, impulse, and mechanical clearances independently
evidence_and_rationale: V/D/M: Coilcraft PDF p. 1; TDK pp. 2,4; DCS:484–488,745–757; SPEC:row 12b

Stage18 RES_A reroute and T1's SW_A-end position resolve a prior board gap; T1 datasheet lacks application HF/working-voltage/PD declaration. Coil winding qualification is proposed, not performed. Confirm with manufacturer/certifier and assembly dielectric/PD test.

criteria.topic: Maintain a current exact-part qualification record
evidence_and_rationale: D/V: BOM:7,37,63–64; S`parts.ato`:90–102,405–415; TDK source JSON P`validation-results/07-conducted-emi/sources/tdk-b82726s2203a020.json`
Exact L1/T1/BOM and footprints are pinned, and current vendor revisions recorded. Physical incoming part, pin identity, coil build and module inductor remain to qualify.

criteria.topic: Model the installed filter with actual terminations
evidence_and_rationale: M: EMI:source/receiver sections, `results.json`; DCS:792–807

Updated October 13 model predicts 10.5 dB nominal, ≥6.5 dB sensitivity using enclosure-study coil→PE capacitance; off-board module is specified as an electrical target, not populated exact parts. Measure source/load Z and unfiltered/filtered LISN spectra.

criteria.topic: Examine the whole filter's resonance and damping
evidence_and_rationale: M/D: DCS:477–478,76–79; EMI:limitations and recommendations 2,5

The ~16 kHz DM/X-cap mode and damper-open/startup peaks are identified, while actual coupled module/rectifier dynamics and bias heat remain open. A peak can magnify stress or shift noise modes. Select/build module and measure impedance plus startup/damper-fault transients.

criteria.topic: Keep common and differential behavior separate for L1
evidence_and_rationale: V/M: TDK p. 4 (1.6 mH per winding, 18 µH typical leakage); EMI:network and 80/18 µH sensitivity

The 18 µH leakage is not 1.6 mH DM inductance; model says an 18 µH-only module misses 9–150 kHz by 5.1 dB, hence ≥100 µH module requirement. Its real bias response is unspecified. Measure both installed modes at hot current.

criteria.topic: Place the filter at the boundary it protects
evidence_and_rationale: D/M: frozen four-layer copper image; position CSV L1/J1; EMI:CM path table

Board entry/filter geometry can be inspected, but the separate module, mains harness, PE bond and chassis corridor are not a frozen assembled artifact. Obtain wiring/metal drawing and scan for bypass.

criteria.topic: Keep shunt-capacitor return paths short and intentional
evidence_and_rationale: D/M: N:2620–2652 C1–C4/PE; EMI:receiver/filter and PE-bond assumptions
Y-cap returns are wired to PE in the netlist; 100 nH/10 mΩ bond in the model is assumed, with no measured inductance or assembly route. Measure PE loop and mode currents in final assembly.

criteria.topic: Measure parasitic input/output coupling around filter parts
evidence_and_rationale: D/M: exact-build copper image, position CSV, EMI:network and limitations

L1 sits near the entry and away from bridge copper in the board view, supporting separation; module-to-board wiring and high-frequency coupling above ~1–3 MHz remain unmodeled. Near-field scan and A/B port test.

criteria.topic: Validate X/Y capacitor and PE interaction as a system
evidence_and_rationale: D/M: N:2622–2652; EMI:recommendation 2 and limitations; bench plan B4

Board C3/C4 and module Y caps are modeled; about 0.48 mA per line at 140 V is only a calculated Y contribution, not an applicable touch-current verdict. Confirm product requirements, approvals, PE continuity, leakage and discharge on full unit.

criteria.topic: Match ferrite suppression to the actual spectrum
evidence_and_rationale: D: BOM and frozen S`*.ato` search; EMI:mitigations
No separate bead/cable ferrite selected in STAGE19B; the ferrite-core L1 is covered by MAG-05/10/15/21. Reopen if a suppression ferrite is added.

criteria.topic: Do not use product-family claims as immunity evidence
evidence_and_rationale: V/M: TDK p. 5 typical curve; EMI:mode results
Exact L1 curve is modeled, but no installed measured noise band or candidate core A/B response establishes immunity or margin. Run mode spectra and hot installed impedance before core substitution.

criteria.topic: Characterize the external induction coil with representative pans
evidence_and_rationale: M: TANK:1–18,37–43; SPEC:1–17 and acceptance-test section

70 µH, installed 66.5 µH, coupling and pan Monte Carlo are explicitly assumed. No received coil and representative hot/offset-pan complex-impedance sweep. This blocks tank release and full-power yield claims.

criteria.topic: Derive tank resonance, circulating current, and device stress from that characterization
evidence_and_rationale: M: TANK:method, bank table and recommendations; DCS:509–530,573–578

Full-bridge/tank model includes 28 A and 29.4 A controls, 0.50 µF bank, 35–60 kHz; its predicted bank current reaches 1.12× TDK's 85 °C curve at 28 A, making local hot-spot evidence decisive. Capture bank voltage/current and switch waveforms at representative corners.

criteria.topic: Optimize coil conductor for AC loss, not DCR alone
evidence_and_rationale: M: DCS:543–546; SPEC:rows 4–8, acceptance-test section

R36 litz estimate 116–136 mΩ at 40 kHz/100 °C gives 91–107 W at 28 A, while 0.25 Ω acceptance edge gives 196 W; no wound-coil R_ac or hot-soak measurement. Measure 20–60 kHz R_ac and ferrite heat on received coils.

criteria.topic: Measure T1 burden, magnetizing error, and frequency response
evidence_and_rationale: D/V/M: N:3370–3380; Coilcraft PDF p. 1; CT:112–123; PICK:CT detector
R39=1.5 Ω and C42=100 nF are local, CT band modeled 64.55–76.09 A; 46.3/638 V·µs at 160 A is a model bound. Calibrate amplitude, phase/droop and trip over 35–60 kHz, hot and fault range.

criteria.topic: Confirm transformer reset and fault behavior
evidence_and_rationale: D/M: S`power_stage_120v.ato`:737–756; P`validation-results/06-controller-interface/outputs/ct_open_secondary.json`; CT:112–115

Local burden is a sound mitigation, but the older open-secondary model predicts >200 V peaks and core saturation if the burden path opens; the higher STAGE19B envelope is not retested. This can stress SELV sensing and erase CT protection. Verify burden connection integrity, clamp behavior and a safely bounded open-path fault at current settings.

criteria.topic: Quantify transformer leakage versus interwinding capacitance
evidence_and_rationale: V/M: Coilcraft PDF p. 1; EMI:CM path table/limitations

Reinforced construction and 3.2 mH are specified, but T1 interwinding capacitance, leakage, installed CM injection and high-frequency phase transfer are not given. Measure/parasitic-extract CT in the actual board.

criteria.topic: Map stray field to sensitive functions and metalwork
evidence_and_rationale: M/D: PICK:2–40 and CT detector section; DCS:502–507,791; position CSV

The field/loop calculation used stage13b/14 copper at 22 A; stage15 scaled its CT pickup number to 28 A. DCS:791 only proves 19→19b copper changes, not equivalence to stage14. Re-extract STAGE19B sense-loop geometry, then probe CT/OCP/LINE_ZC under hot pan-position scans.

criteria.topic: Preserve measurement observability in the physical design
evidence_and_rationale: D: EMI`BENCH-PRECOMPLIANCE.md`:equipment/B1–B9; DCS:807

The procedure is concrete, yet PE test point, removable R38 and current-probe windows are deferred to a later spin, and module/coil access is an assembly question. Instrumenting can alter the very CM path being measured. Prove repeatable fixtures and correlate probe-on/off before accepting an EMI or CT conclusion.

criteria.topic: Map every bridge state before naming a “hot loop.”
evidence_and_rationale: Observed design: `S:222–236,380–448,715–725`; pad map above; model: `E/01-switching-parasitics/round17/d2/README.md:394–415,506–559`.

Both driven diagonals close through R5 and C38–C41. Dead-time diode/Coss paths and burst/fault signed-current maps are not complete on the frozen revision; treating the whole tank route as the fastest loop would be wrong. No failing waveform is claimed.
Marked layer/state overlay for both current signs, including dead time, burst start, fault disable and diode/snubber current. Capture commutation current and switch-node timing.

criteria.topic: Local DC-link closure at both bridge legs
evidence_and_rationale: Observed pads: Q2/C38/C39 and Q5/C40/C41 coordinates above; `S:715–725`; model: `E/01-switching-parasitics/round17/d2/README.md:506–556`.

Film caps are deliberately 24 mm below the FET row to retain gate network room. Prior native-21 FEM estimated leg-A parallel commutation loop 32.0 nH provisionally vs 19.4 nH native-19, then F6 model cases passed its internal screens. `HV_RET` reaches `LEG_RET` through R5, so negative-cap closure cannot be judged by positive-pad distance. Mounted cap, shunt and package impedance and stage19b waveform margin remain unverified.
Extract both full cap→FET→R5→cap paths including mounting/stack; test VDS and bus ripple at Q2–Q6 pins over operating corners.

criteria.topic: Minimize effective loop area, not merely trace length
evidence_and_rationale: Modelled: `E/01-switching-parasitics/round17/d2/README.md:506–570`; observed: three geometry checks above; `B:35–75`.

The leg-A/leg-B coupled-loop matrices do compare returns and mutual coupling, and the cap-row move was accepted for F6. Effective area is not inferable from one trace length. FEM remains provisional for some fine corrections and enclosure coupling; no measured field or overshoot margin.
Re-extract both exact STAGE19B power loops with closures and compare a cap-row/gate-network alternative on equal thermal and insulation constraints; near-field correlate.

criteria.topic: Control the switch-node copper deliberately
evidence_and_rationale: Modelled area/capacitance: `E/07-conducted-emi/s19b/README.md` §3, SW_A 1.93e-3 m² / SW_B 3.31e-3 m², assumed chassis 15 mm; observed `P/copper-dump.json` zones.

The large nodes carry the tank to T1/C21 and are explicitly in the CM model, including low-side tab capacitance; no universal node-area limit applies. The actual enclosure/coil/heatsink capacitances and heating trade are not measured.
Measure node-to-PE/coil capacitance and CM currents; assess candidate area reduction against copper temperature and full tank-current path.

criteria.topic: Preserve a close mirror-current path where permitted
evidence_and_rationale: Observed filled-zone samples and `B:35–75`; modelled native-21 FEM `E/01-switching-parasitics/round17/d2/README.md:506–570`.

FET-row In1 is not continuous at sampled Q-drain locations; In2 `bus_p` sits underneath. Farther down, `hv_ret` In1 and `bus_p` In2 are paired. This is a deliberate four-layer rail geometry, but image current and local gaps are not proven by the layer name or DRC.
Plot RF current density and return voltage in In1/In2 for each transition, including the gap near `y=8`; check isolation before any plane extension.

criteria.topic: Keep quiet ground attachments out of the hot-loop shield region
evidence_and_rationale: Missing current map; observed `P/return-path.json` covers named signal references; zone samples `(68,20),(10,20),(50,11)`.
The signal gate verifies selected reference changes, not the power-loop mirror-current density or every quiet via attachment. No safe quiet attachment region has been identified for each hot loop.
Overlay controller/sense/filter vias on a solved RF current-density map; measure Kelvin/driver-reference bounce at real pins.

criteria.topic: Keep high-current thermal paths compatible with RF geometry
evidence_and_rationale: Calculated/modelled: `D:808–834`, `E/04-board-current-thermal/round5-native21/b3-convergence/README.md`; observed pad/pour geometry above.

Converged 28 A h25 model reports R5 element 140 °C and FET-row copper 126 °C; it explicitly retains h10 derating and film-cap/local-air bench holds. The elongated cap/rail geometry is an accepted RF/thermal compromise, not an empirically validated one.
IR/thermocouple map at 22→28 A, h25 and stall h10, plus switch-node/EMI waveform at same points.

criteria.topic: Close each low-side gate-charge loop
evidence_and_rationale: Observed U1/U2 at `y=46.125`, Q3/Q6 at `y=4.215`, R12/R20 at `y=14.062`; `S:125–143,204–229`; modelled F6 gate loops `E/01-switching-parasitics/round17/d2/README.md:527–585`.

Driver caps C8/C15 and reservoirs are local to driver pins, while gate/source paths span the FET–driver distance. The source is `LEG_RET`, shared with bridge current, and no Kelvin source pin exists on TO-247-3; modelled negative bias mitigates false turn-on. Gate-to-source pin waveforms are missing.
Measure VGS across Q3/Q6 gate/source *device pins* and driver VSSB during both partner edges and fault disable; preserve current/temperature corners.

criteria.topic: Close each high-side floating-driver and bootstrap loop
evidence_and_rationale: F6 uses monitored split, transformer-derived bias; PS2/TCO owns it, and **there is no bootstrap recharge network**, so bootstrap-specific recharge is NA. The high-side loop still travels to the remote Q source through `SW_A/B` and local bias network, with modelled but unmeasured negative-bias margin.
Scope VDDA−VSSA and VGS at Q2/Q5 pins through startup, burst, worst partner edge and PS2/TCO decay.

criteria.topic: Treat driver-supply decoupling as a separate AC loop
evidence_and_rationale: Observed `S:125–173`; U1/U2, C8/C10/C15/C17 pad positions; `P/bypass-check.json` 11/11 selected IC bypass checks; `P/pi-distances.json` U41/U42/U26 pin/cap distances.

100 nF/1 µF/10 µF driver stacks and STAGE19 relocated converter/LDO caps have an explicit layout rationale. PI `pass=true` asserts supply distances; some return distances (C104 5.70 mm, C108 5.69, C98 6.97) are recorded but **not asserted**, so the gate does not prove every complete rail loop.
Check actual pad-to-pad loop impedance and driver droop at pin pairs while switching; qualify output-cap returns as well as positive pins.

criteria.topic: Route current-sense inputs as a small receiving loop
evidence_and_rationale: `S:380–386,425–448,735–755`; observed R5 Kelvin pads `(37,12.1)/(37,13.1)`, T1 at `(135,110)`; `P/return-path.json` selected CT/protection checks; `D:778–790`.

R5 has Kelvin fingers and the SI1 fault route was moved over its intended reference; T1 terminates on-board before J4. CT_S2 and CT_MON still have long, multi-via routed copper; the checks do not establish actual pickup or comparator noise/timing margin.
Differential probe at R5 fingers and comparator pins, CT burden and zero-cross at 22/28 A; include fault timing versus filter delay.

criteria.topic: Keep control and measurement references out of fast-field paths
evidence_and_rationale: Historical exact-board gate `P/return-path.json`: `pwm_hb` seven transfer changes now C14/C142/C47/C153–C156 ≤3 mm; `D:785–790`; observed caps C153–C156 coordinates above.

STAGE19B closes the known J4-side PWM return gap. `bias_bad` still has seven 2.81–15.76 mm reference changes and an edge band run, but D records fault-only fail-safe behavior; that is a supported rationale, not RF immunity proof. No operational noise injection exists.
Pin-level PWM, DIS and sense-reference measurements with worst bridge transitions; inject reference noise to test false disable and timing.

criteria.topic: Establish a quiet filter boundary and return
evidence_and_rationale: The board filter is only one stage; a separate, **not yet selected/assembled** 100 µH DM + CM inlet module is mandatory. The quiet/noisy boundary depends on enclosure wiring. C3/C4 PE attachments and C2 are displaced from L1 outputs, so their HF return impedance and possible bypass around the series element require physical mapping. This is a concrete integration risk, not a measured emission violation.
Freeze module schematic/layout/harness and map L/N/PE RF return, both sides of L1, with current probes and LISN scans.

criteria.topic: Make the filter path pass through its capacitor pads
evidence_and_rationale: Same L1/C1–C4 pad geometry above; `P/copper-dump.json` and `P/copper.png`; off-board topology `E/07-conducted-emi/s19b/README.md` §3.

C2/Y-cap centre offsets of roughly 30–56 mm from L1 output pads alone do **not** prove a stub or bypass, yet they make an HF pad-through path uncertain. The mandatory inlet module's capacitor placements are not present in the board package. Exact HF series lead/trace inductance is unqualified.
Trace both conductors pad by pad on the assembled module and board; impedance or current-injection measure cap effectiveness; compare with intended filter model.

criteria.topic: Check magnetic coupling around filter inductors
evidence_and_rationale: Observed L1 `(232,31)`, board bridge FET row y4; missing final inlet module, coil/harness axes and field data (`D:70,792–807`; `E/07-conducted-emi/s19b/README.md` limitations).
Board spacing alone cannot establish coupling from the external induction coil or module choke/DM inductor; their installed orientation and fields are essential inputs.
Fix enclosure coordinates and magnetics orientation, measure L1/module inductance and conducted attenuation at 15 A/28 A tank with coil energized.

criteria.topic: Evaluate conducted and common-mode routes separately
evidence_and_rationale: Modelled `E/07-conducted-emi/s19b/README.md` §§3–9; `D:792–807`; observed `P/copper-dump.json`.

Separate DM 2fs bus-current and CM coil/low-side-tab/chassis routes are modelled. Updated R43 enclosure estimate gives 31.0 pF floating-pan coil→PE and predicted worst 6.5 dB sensitivity margin; earthed-pan informational case falls to 1.7–2.6 dB. Above ~1–3 MHz, harness and RF parasitics are unmodelled, so this is not a measured compliance margin.
Assembled capacitance and DM/CM LISN-current checks; validate module at 9 kHz–30 MHz, including earthed-pan robustness.

criteria.topic: Verify filter/source impedance and stability
evidence_and_rationale: Missing module source/DM inductor, startup/burst coupled response; `E/07-conducted-emi/s19b/README.md` §§3,8–9 and `D:70,792–807`.

The 100 µH DM inlet module and its damping are a model allocation, while 15 A bias retention, actual source impedance, inrush/stall and coupled board+module resonance have not been qualified. A frequency-domain emissions model cannot settle these modes.
Select rated parts, measure L/ESR versus bias/temperature and source impedance, run coupled transient/inrush and input-current stability tests.

criteria.topic: Do not trade insulation for a close image plane
evidence_and_rationale: Historical exact-board barrier gates `D:789–791`: 0 barrier/RES_A violations, D5 8.047/8.507 mm; `B:35–75` dielectric stack; `S:1–20,~690–714`; source-specific rule file `section.kicad_dru`.

The candidate preserves the HV/SELV barrier and the near planes are net-specific rather than an indiscriminate added shield. DRC/geometry verify only configured spacing; dielectric/partial-discharge, chassis overlap, manufacturing tolerance and leakage/current requirements remain to be confirmed. No general AN-139 buck plane spacing applies.
Validate pin-specific insulation basis, bare-board/assembly tolerances and dielectric tests; quantify barrier capacitance with final enclosure/module.

criteria.topic: Use field/impedance evidence for proposed layout improvements
evidence_and_rationale: Modelled native-21 vs native-19 loop change `E/01-switching-parasitics/round17/d2/README.md:506–559`; STAGE19/19B exact-board PI/SI checks `D:767–791`; thermal `D:808–834`.

The cap-row trade has paired FEM and switching-model evidence; STAGE19B transfer-cap additions have before/after return geometry and unchanged power-copper/thermal checks. There is no paired *measured* overshoot, temperature and EMI comparison for the same exact board/operating point, and some prior FEM screens remain provisional.
Matched A/B prototype or validated exact-board field/thermal/EMI study, with unchanged probes, load and airflow.

criteria.topic: Plan repeatable EMI precompliance and probing
evidence_and_rationale: Test plan `E/07-conducted-emi/s19b/BENCH-PRECOMPLIANCE.md` equipment/settings/C1–C6/B1–B9; updated model `E/07-conducted-emi/s19b/README.md` final section.

Detailed LISN, receiver, modes, loads and probe-removal/matched comparisons are written. However B1/B5/B6 still cite older 50 pF/7.8 dB predictions while the 2026-10-13 model uses 31 pF/10.5 dB; that discrepancy must be reconciled before executing or judging the test. No scans exist.
Revise bench sheet to final model and lab-agreed standard/fixture, then run calibrated scans and archive raw settings/traces.

criteria.topic: Diagnose unexpected spectral lines before tuning copper
evidence_and_rationale: Missing actual STAGE19B spectral and time-domain captures; model `E/07-conducted-emi/s19b/README.md` §3/limitations; test plan C5/B7.

Only ideal held/swept harmonic predictions exist. Burst, phase shift and incidental skipping can create nonharmonic lines, but no unexplained measured peak has yet been identified. Assigning NA would assume the behavior away.
On first EMI scan, link any nonharmonic lines to simultaneous low-loop gate/switch timing, then remove probes and repeat the EMI trace.
